adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the reschedule-merge cleanup still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` (see the unchanged block just after the new loop over `calendarReference`). Elsewhere in the same diff, `_calendar` references are explicitly handled as an array (e.g., `calendarReference = ...filter(...)` and looping over all references), and event creation now supports multiple destination calendars/hosts. Because the merge deletion still uses `find`, it will only delete one old calendar event reference, leaving any additional `_calendar` references (now possible per host) undeleted/orphaned.
